I just went there today. The counter staff were terrible; they spoke as if I was getting free treatment. However, this isn't about the doctor; the doctor was nice and gave good advice. The staff were awful. I understand that some medications might not be available or might be out of stock, and you could have told me nicely and told me to find them myself. But your attitude was terrible, especially when you implied that I came here on my own initiative. The pharmacist even told me that this particular medication isn't sold there; it's a prescription drug regularly kept by a specialist doctor. It has to be a medication prescribed by a specialist and kept on hand at their clinic. Pharmacies don't stock it; if you want it, you have to pre-order it, which means pre-ordering 100 pills at 35 baht each. But in reality, we only need one pill a day for 10 days.
The pharmacist tried to find a comparable medication, but there was nothing that could replace or be used as a substitute. So they told us to call the clinic to have them get the medication for us because we were sick and needed it. We called the clinic and asked if we could talk to the doctor and get the medication for us because if we bought it in time, we would have already bought 100 pills. It's unacceptable for a patient to have to buy this type of medication in such large quantities. The cost of visiting the clinic alone was over 1000 baht, and now we have to buy the medication outside ourselves, but the service was like they were treating us for free. The response was, "You have to wait." I was confused about how long I, the patient, would have to wait for the medication. During the medical history taking, the doctor mentioned several medications he wanted to prescribe, but ultimately only gave me one and told me to buy the rest myself. He also said, "You're not the only one; I've given everyone the same prescription." I paid for my treatment, and the receipt says "medication cost," but he didn't give me any of the medication! He then said, "If you're not satisfied, go to a hospital; don't come to the clinic because it's slower." I willingly paid for my treatment and received good medication, but the clinic is even worse than the hospital! I'm completely shocked. (The counter staff needs to be replaced.)

text: I'm seeing Dr. Rattanawadee for my prenatal care. She's very kind and gives excellent advice. The assistants in the clinic are also very polite. However, the staff at the counter are incredibly rude, as if we're asking for free services. They've been rude every time I've visited, and the last time was particularly bad. I had my prenatal care with Dr. Rattanawadee. She was an excellent caregiver and gave great advice. During every check-up, she took her time and examined me thoroughly. Even during delivery, she visited me every day while I was hospitalized – so kind! The price was very affordable, and they provided snacks while I waited. There was convenient parking. If I have another child, I will definitely see her again 😊 Most importantly, my C-section scar is beautiful – you can't even see it! The surgery was very quick, and the atmosphere was fun, which helped reduce my anxiety. Dr. Rattanawadee's assistant, Nong Sai, was also very lovely and provided excellent service; she was very polite.
